tasks.build:all: mkdir -p dist && deno task build:linux && deno task build:linux-arm && deno task build:mac && deno task build:mac-arm && deno task build:windows
tasks.build:current: mkdir -p dist && deno compile --engine quickjs --allow-env --allow-net --allow-read --allow-write --output dist/poke poke.ts
tasks.build:current:v8: mkdir -p dist && deno compile --engine v8 --allow-env --allow-net --allow-read --allow-write --output dist/poke-v8 poke.ts
tasks.build:linux: deno compile --engine quickjs --allow-env --allow-net --allow-read --allow-write --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --output dist/poke-linux-x86_64 poke.ts
tasks.build:linux-arm: deno compile --engine quickjs --allow-env --allow-net --allow-read --allow-write --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --output dist/poke-linux-aarch64 poke.ts
tasks.build:mac: deno compile --engine quickjs --allow-env --allow-net --allow-read --allow-write --target x86_64-apple-darwin --output dist/poke-darwin-x86_64 poke.ts
tasks.build:mac-arm: deno compile --engine quickjs --allow-env --allow-net --allow-read --allow-write --target aarch64-apple-darwin --output dist/poke-darwin-aarch64 poke.ts
tasks.build:windows: deno compile --engine quickjs --allow-env --allow-net --allow-read --allow-write --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --output dist/poke-windows-x86_64.exe poke.ts
tasks.fmt: deno fmt poke.ts src tests README.md deno.json
tasks.check: deno fmt --check poke.ts src tests README.md deno.json && deno lint poke.ts src tests && deno check poke.ts && deno task test
